question: A rectangular tin sheet is 32 cm long and 14 cm wide. It is rolled along its length to form a cylinder, with opposite edges just touching each other. Find the volume (in cm³) of the cylinder.
solution:
**Given:**

Length of the rectangular tin sheet = 32 cm

Width of the rectangular tin sheet = 14 cm

**Formula used:**

Circumference of the base of the cylinder = Length of the tin sheet

Volume of the cylinder = π × r² × h

Where,

r = radius of the base of the cylinder, h = height of the cylinder
